Prepare, Practice, and Perfect Your UX Research

Get interview feedback, practice with avatars, and streamline your research process—all with Verita AI.

Avatar-Based Training

Practice interviewing with AI avatars that simulate real user responses. Perfect for entry-level researchers to gain confidence and learn in a risk-free environment before the real thing.

Personalized Feedback

Receive tailored feedback to improve your research techniques and methodologies.

Research Interview Preparation

Verita helps you generate a list of questions based on your prompts. You can even practice with avatars to gauge how long your interview will take and identify which questions will give you the best insights, ensuring you’re fully prepared for every session.

Actionable
Insights

Verita automatically generates user journey maps from your research, highlights key insights, and prompts ‘How Might We’ (HMW) questions to inspire innovative solutions. Streamline your analysis and take the next steps with confidence.

Team Collaboration

Work seamlessly with your team to deliver outstanding research results.
